user.title: Connect to InfoMentor
user.description:
Choose how to approve the login with BankID.

- **QR code**: you use Home Assistant on a computer or tablet and have BankID on your phone.
- **This phone**: Home Assistant and BankID are on the same phone.

The refresh token is only needed if BankID cannot be used.

menu_options.bankid: BankID with QR code (scan with your phone)

reauth.title: InfoMentor rejected the login
reauth.description:
InfoMentor needs you to log in again. Choose how to approve the login with BankID.

- **QR code**: you use Home Assistant on a computer or tablet and have BankID on your phone.
- **This phone**: Home Assistant and BankID are on the same phone.

The refresh token is only needed if BankID cannot be used.

menu_options.bankid: BankID with QR code (scan with your phone)

bankid.title: Log in with BankID
bankid.description: The login did not finish. Press **Submit** to try again with a new QR code.

token.title: Connect with a refresh token
token.description: Paste an OAuth2 refresh token from the InfoMentor Hub mobile grant. Only needed when BankID cannot be used.

children.title: Choose children
children.description: Select which linked children should get entities in Home Assistant.

bankid_phone.title: Log in with BankID on this phone
bankid_phone.description: The login did not finish. Press **Submit** to try again. You get a new link to the BankID app.

progress.bankid_scan:
1. Open the {qr_link_start}QR code{qr_link_end}. It opens in a new tab.
2. Open the BankID app on your phone and tap **Scan QR code**.
3. Point the camera at the code and approve the login in the app.
4. Come back here. The dialog moves on by itself.

Keep this dialog open in the meantime, because closing it stops the QR code from working.
progress.bankid_phone_scan:
1. Tap [Open BankID]({launch_url}). The BankID app opens.
2. Approve the login in the app.
3. Come back to Home Assistant. The dialog moves on by itself.

Does the dialog stay put after you approved? Close it and log in again.
Does the BankID app not open? Log in with a QR code from a computer instead.

error.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different InfoMentor account.
error.bankid_cancelled: The BankID login was cancelled or declined.
